summary.en: AI coding IDE. The winget manifest lists signed win32-arm64 installers on kiro.dev's download host.
summary.zh-TW: AI 程式開發 IDE，winget 清單提供 kiro.dev 下載主機上的 win32-arm64 簽章安裝程式。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
